intro: Welcome to Mogger Mon.$Build a lineup, push through battles, and grow your archive one weird recruit at a time.$This demo already supports full battles, maxxing, relic drafting, and recruit management, even while the broader content pass is still in progress.$If the game runs slowly, make sure hardware acceleration is enabled in your browser settings.
accessMenu: To open the field menu, press M or Escape whenever the game is waiting for your input.$The menu holds settings, run tools, and archive shortcuts.
menu: Use this menu to tune speed, window style, and other run settings.$It also holds your main utility screens, so it is worth learning early.
starterSelect: This is your Pokebox draft screen.$Press Z or the Space bar to tag recruits for your starting lineup.$Each recruit has a value, and your lineup can hold up to 6 members as long as the total stays within 10.$If you have unlocked them, you can also choose gender, trait, and form variants before the run begins.$A species will use the best IV spread you've decoded for it so far, so a deeper archive gives you stronger opening options.
pokerus:
A daily random 5 selectable recruits have a purple border.$If you see a recruit you own with one of these,
try adding it to your lineup. Be sure to check its summary!
statChange: Stat changes persist across battles as long as your Mogger Mon aren't recalled.$Your Mogger Mon are recalled before a mogmaster battle and before entering a new biome.$You can view the stat changes for any Mogger Mon on the field by holding C or Shift.$You can also view the technique set for an enemy Mogger Mon by holding V.$This only reveals techniques that you've seen the enemy use this battle.
selectItem: After each battle you will be offered 3 random relics, and you may claim only 1.$These range from consumables to held gear to permanent passive upgrades.$Most passive relics stack, and some only appear when your team can actually use them, such as maxx relics.$Held relics can be transferred between Mogger Mon once you unlock the transfer option in the bottom-right corner.$You can also spend cash on consumables before finalizing your random relic pick.
eggGacha: Here you can redeem vouchers for Signal Pods.$Pods technique closer to decoding after every battle, and rarer Pods take longer to open.$Decoded Mogger Mon are added to your recruit pool rather than your active lineup.$Pod recruits usually arrive with stronger IVs than field recruits, and some Mogger Mon can only be found this way.$Each machine has a different bonus profile, so pick the one that best matches what your archive needs next.
